description: This file defines the MaterialsProviderInterface in the Aws\Crypto namespace, serving as an interface for cryptographic materials providers in the AWS SDK for PHP. It specifies methods for key size support, envelope processing, wrap algorithm retrieval, and key/IV generation.

classes.name: MaterialsProviderInterface
classes.description: An interface for cryptographic materials providers in AWS SDK for PHP, defining methods for key management and encryption operations.

methods.name: isSupportedKeySize
methods.description: Checks if a given key size in bits is supported by AES.

methods.name: fromDecryptionEnvelope
methods.description: Performs additional setup for the provider based on data from a MetadataEnvelope.

methods.name: getWrapAlgorithmName
methods.description: Returns the name of the wrap algorithm used by this provider.

methods.name: decryptCek
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted content encryption key (CEK) using the provider.

methods.name: generateCek
methods.description: Generates a random content encryption key of specified size.

methods.name: generateIv
methods.description: Generates an initialization vector based on the OpenSSL cipher name.
